A1.justification: Both PDFs are complete, readable 32-page versions of the same study. Their main text, Appendices A–L, equations, 12 tables, and 19 figures support reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports an original 20-participant human study, neural-network feature-suppression experiments across three domains, and appendix ablations and controls.

after.justification: v3 retains the original human-study and model-evaluation results, including quantitative transformation validation and supplementary experiments.

M1.justification: Section 4 and Table 1 retain the same suppression framework and six transformations for shape, texture, and color. No algorithm, model component, or inference procedure changes.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the curated ImageNet16 human/model task and the same five CV, five MedMNIST, and five remote-sensing datasets. The appendices retain the same test scenarios.

E2.justification: Tables 2, 3, 6, and 8 retain the same transformation comparators, model architectures, decision-rule variants, and grid-overlay controls. No evaluated comparator is added or removed.

E3.justification: Section 5.2 replaces the statement that medical images were resized to 224×224 with use of the standardized 224×224 version, a limited revision to the reported input-preparation specification without establishing a rerun. The newly explicit CV scratch-training option was already documented in v1 Appendix I.2 and Table 12.

E4.justification: The kernel-parameter ablation, decision-rule comparison, class-wise analysis, pretraining comparisons, alternative and joint suppression analyses, and block-artifact control are retained. The new reference to Appendix I.5 points to an existing experiment.

E5.justification: Appendix F retains the paired tests with n=4 per group, effect sizes, power, 95% confidence intervals, and noise-ceiling estimates. Participant counts and domain-level 1-sigma error-bar reporting also remain unchanged.

E6.justification: Reported numerical results and plotted findings are retained throughout the main text and appendices. For example, Table 3 retains local-shape relative accuracies of 0.276 for ResNet50-standard, 0.647 for ConvNeXtV2, and 0.763 for humans; no result entries are added or removed.

T1.justification: Appendices A and B retain the same metric definitions and relative-accuracy equations (1–11). Renaming Figure 8's preservation label does not alter gradient correlation or its mathematical definition.

C1.justification: The abstract, contributions, and conclusion retain the claims of predominant local-shape reliance rather than inherent texture bias, mitigation through modern training, and domain-dependent feature reliance.

C2.justification: Mechanism explanations and limitations concerning feature interdependence, incomplete suppression, transformation artifacts, augmentation confounds, and constrained human testing remain unchanged. The edge-to-shape terminology edit follows the existing interpretation of gradient correlation.

D1.justification: Section 5.2 more specifically identifies the standardized 224×224 MedMNIST version, refining the information available for reproduction. Code-access information, hardware, training times, and hyperparameter Tables 9–12 remain unchanged.

R1.justification: Both versions retain the same 66 references and research positioning. The added introduction citation [8] repeats an already cited Geirhos study rather than introducing another work or changing the critique.

P1.justification: V3 makes localized wording and grammar edits, adds explicit references to Appendices C, D, and I.5, and adds EU project funding acknowledgements. Section ordering and the overall narrative structure remain intact.

P2.justification: Figure 8(b) and its caption change 'Edge Preservation' to 'Shape Preservation'. Other changes are limited caption edits, table spacing, and local text reflow; figures and tables are neither added nor removed.

improvement.justification: V3 modestly improves documentation by specifying the MedMNIST image version, aligning the main CV training description with scratch-training experiments already in the appendix, and adding direct pointers to existing validation analyses. These refinements aid interpretation and reproduction, while the experimental evidence, core claims, and limitations remain unchanged.
